author: hoenored
body:
Trapp is a unique Capture the Wool map, featuring different region kits, and a see-through wool room.

 Objective

 The object of the game is to get the wool on the other team's side, and bring it back, placing it on your monument. In order to get into the wool room, you must break blocks and fall down the hole. Once down there, the blocks will regenerate above you. To get out, you do the exact same thing, but you must go up. Once the wool has been brought to your team's side, and you place it on the monument, your team wins!

Defender Spawnkit (Gained while on your team's side): 

Leather armor

Stone Sword

Bow

32 Arrows

Wooden Axe

Wooden Pickaxe

24 Dark Oak Planks

3 Gapples

Attacker Spawnkit (Gained while on the enemy's side): 

Leather armor

Stone Sword

Bow

32 Arrows

Wooden Axe

Wooden Pickaxe

32 Dark Oak Planks

6 Gapples

Woolroom Spawnkit (Gained while in the wool room):

Chain Chestplate

Iron Leggings

Iron Sword Bow

32 Arrows

Wooden Axe

Wooden Pickaxe

64 Dark Oak Planks 

32 Gapples

 Links

 Download (Contains XML, not YML): https://www.dropbox.com/s/1u9299k8twelkkj/Trapp.zip?dl=0

Album (Shaders): http://imgur.com/a/RAaXf

Album (Vanilla Minecraft): http://imgur.com/a/xXDIh
